title: Shell
description: Layout primitives that dock blocks into a dense tool: Pane, PaneHeader, Toolbar and Section, with resizable and collapsible pane groups.
docs: Render every block inside a Pane: a PaneHeader and a Toolbar at its top, the rest in a PaneContent, which scrolls. Dock panes in a PaneGroup (orientation horizontal or vertical), which needs a parent with a height; a pane can hold another PaneGroup. Put a PaneHandle between two panes to let the user resize them. Pane takes react-resizable-panels' Panel props: numbers for defaultSize, minSize and maxSize are pixels, and collapsible gives its PaneHeader a collapse button. Set side="end" on a pane docked to the right or bottom. Set density on a PaneGroup or Pane for everything inside it: comfortable for data entry, compact for lists and inspectors. Sizes come from the --dhis2-control-h, --dhis2-row-h, --dhis2-pane-pad, --dhis2-gap and --dhis2-text tokens; do not add heights, font sizes, padding, radius, cards or shadows around a pane's content. Give a Toolbar at most one primary ToolbarButton.
